meta.name: Route omnichannel customer support with Ollama and Postgres pgvector

parameters.query: WITH c AS (INSERT INTO cs_conversations(tenant_id,conversation_id,customer_id,last_channel) VALUES ($1,gen_random_uuid(),$2,$3) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,customer_id) DO UPDATE SET last_channel=EXCLUDED.last_channel,updated_at=now() RETURNING conversation_id,status,summary), m AS (INSERT INTO cs_messages(tenant_id,provider_event_id,conversation_id,channel,direction,body,metadata) SELECT $1,$4,conversation_id,$3,'inbound',$5,$6::jsonb FROM c ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,provider_event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING provider_event_id), h AS (SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY created_at DESC) history FROM (SELECT direction,body,channel,created_at FROM cs_messages WHERE conversation_id=(SELECT conversation_id FROM c) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 12) x) SELECT c.*,COALESCE((SELECT provider_event_id FROM m),'') inserted_event,COALESCE(h.history,'[]'::jsonb) history FROM c,h;

SELECT content,source,1-(embedding <=> $1::vector) AS score FROM cs_kb_chunks WHERE tenant_id=$2 AND published=true AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>now()) ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 5;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({model:$env.CS_OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3.1:8b',stream:false,format:'json',messages:[{role:'system',content:'You are a cautious customer-service router. Return JSON only: {intent:faq|order|complaint|other,confidence:0..1,reply:string,order_id:string|null,complaint_category:string|null,needs_human:boolean,reason:string,citations:string[]}. Never invent policy or order status. FAQs must cite supplied sources. Orders involving payment, refund, cancellation, address change, account access or any mutation need human. Escalate threats, legal/privacy/safety requests, unclear identity, abusive harassment, unknown facts, or confidence below .78.'},{role:'user',content:JSON.stringify({message:$node['Normalize and validate'].json.message,history:$node['Persist and fetch memory'].json.history,knowledge:$input.all().map(i=>({content:i.json.content,source:i.json.source,score:i.json.score}))})}]}) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO cs_handoffs(id,tenant_id,conversation_id,reason,priority,transcript) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(),$1,$2,$3,CASE WHEN $3 ~* 'legal|safety|payment' THEN 'urgent' ELSE 'normal' END,$4::jsonb); UPDATE cs_conversations SET status='waiting_human',updated_at=now() WHERE conversation_id=$2;

parameters.content:
## Route customer-service messages across chat, email and social DMs

**Who is this for:** support teams that need one AI-assisted experience across website chat, email, and social direct messages.

**What it does:** Three webhooks normalize verified inbound events into a shared customer conversation. The workflow de-duplicates events, saves cross-channel memory in PostgreSQL, retrieves approved knowledge with pgvector, and uses Ollama to classify requests as FAQ, order, complaint, or other. It records replies and sends a channel-neutral reply envelope to an outbound adapter.

**Safety:** It hands off low-confidence, unsupported, uncited, payment, refund, cancellation, address-change, legal, privacy, safety, abusive, or unclear-identity cases.

**Setup:** Configure n8n variables, assign the PostgreSQL credential, load approved embedded knowledge, and connect verified channel adapters to the three webhook paths. Keep provider credentials and signature validation in adapters, not this export.

**Customize:** Add intents in Route and guardrail, update its prompt and fixtures, and connect your helpdesk and channel APIs to the generic handoff and reply webhooks.

### 1. Inbound setup

Configure your verified chat, email, and DM adapters to call the matching webhook. Use the Set Fields node as a configuration checklist; keep real secrets in n8n variables.

### 2. Knowledge and memory

Use PostgreSQL + pgvector. Re-embed approved revisions, retain sources, and unpublish obsolete chunks. Memory is shared through the stable customer ID.

### 3. Human handoff and delivery

This path fails closed for risk and uncertainty. Connect generic handoff and reply endpoints to your helpdesk and provider-specific sending service.

# AI Customer Support Across Chat, Email & Social Media

## Who is this template for?

This template is designed for businesses that want to automate customer support across multiple communication channels using AI.

It works with:

- Website Chat
- Email
- Facebook Messenger
- Instagram DM
- WhatsApp (via adapter)
- Any custom messaging platform

The workflow automatically classifies incoming customer messages, retrieves answers from your approved knowledge base, maintains conversation history, and safely escalates complex requests to a human support agent.

---

## What this workflow does

✔ Receives customer messages

✔ Validates incoming requests

✔ Stores conversation history

✔ Retrieves relevant knowledge using pgvector

✔ Uses Ollama to classify customer intent

✔ Detects risky or sensitive conversations

✔ Automatically escalates when necessary

✔ Sends responses back through the correct communication channel

---

## Configuration
## Configure Before Running

Update the variables inside the **Configure Template Variables** node.

Required Variables

- CS_OLLAMA_URL
- CS_OLLAMA_MODEL
- CS_OLLAMA_EMBED_MODEL
- CS_TENANT_SECRET
- CS_HUMAN_WEBHOOK
- CS_REPLY_WEBHOOK

Do **not** hardcode API keys or secrets in HTTP Request nodes.

Use n8n Credentials and Environment Variables whenever possible.

## AI Model

This workflow uses Ollama for local inference.

Default models

• llama3.1:8b

• nomic-embed-text

You can replace these with any compatible local or hosted LLM by updating the HTTP Request nodes.

## Requirements

- n8n
- PostgreSQL + pgvector
- Ollama
- Customer Support Database
- Verified Chat/Email/Social adapters

---

## Before you start

Configure the following variables inside the **Configure Template Variables** node.

- CS_OLLAMA_URL
- CS_OLLAMA_MODEL
- CS_OLLAMA_EMBED_MODEL
- CS_TENANT_SECRET
- CS_HUMAN_WEBHOOK
- CS_REPLY_WEBHOOK

Never store secrets directly inside HTTP Request nodes.

---

## How to customize

You can easily customize:

- Supported intents
- AI prompt
- Human escalation rules
- Knowledge Base
- Supported communication channels
- Outbound integrations

This template is completely modular and each section can be replaced independently.

## Database

This template stores:

• Conversation history
• Customer messages
• AI responses
• Human handoff records

Knowledge search uses PostgreSQL with pgvector.

Rebuild embeddings whenever knowledge articles are updated.
